reuse.why: Builds the schedule with the existing recurConfigToRSchedule/RSchedule and applies the shared applyWeekendRule from shared/schedules.ts instead of re-implementing weekend moves.

duplication.why: Only the RSchedule construction + map(applyWeekendRule)/filter(null) + captureBreadcrumb try/catch skeleton is repeated from getUpcomingDates; no weekend logic is duplicated.

placement.why: New handler sits next to getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered in SchedulesHandlers and app.method like its siblings.

scope.why: Only the handler, its type registration, an import and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Small, readable, with a comment explaining the padded window; the padding constants are a slight implicit coupling to the weekend-shift distance.

disguised_duplication.where: The occurrence-to-day mapping shared with getUpcomingDates is written openly, not disguised; the weekend rule itself is called, not copied.
